'''2003 Maryland State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship in Maryland (April 2003). It is known from the decklists below, recovered from DeckTech posts and Players Committee forms.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS4]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Maryland
* '''Dates:''' April 2003
